summary: Strengthen herd health, feed planning, and field reporting. Explore practical livestock management training for rural development professionals.
lede: Livestock management training gives extension officers, animal-health workers, and rural programme staff practical methods for making field decisions about herds and flocks. Participants practise reviewing livestock records, assessing seasonal feed resources and body condition, and planning biosecurity and herd-health actions. Exercises also connect animal welfare, resource use, and household livelihood priorities through field plans.
audienceIntro: Livestock management training suits professionals responsible for animal production, health, extension, and rural livelihood programmes. It is designed for practitioners with some exposure to livestock systems who need stronger field tools and more consistent plans.
modules: Livestock Value Chains and Field Plans
prerequisites: Prior work exposure to livestock production, animal health, agricultural extension, or rural livelihood programmes is expected. No coding or programming is required.
